data.title: 白面鸮 · 灯下的一句晚安
data.description: 她合上书，把声音放轻，靠近说了一句晚安。说完后，她仍望着你，像在等你的回答。
data.action: 合书侧身，靠近镜头道晚安
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: In a quiet study lounge after hours, Ptilopsis closes her leather research log and leans forward under the warm glow of an adjustable desk lamp. The dark window behind her reflects the softly lit room and distant city lights as she addresses the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Closing her binder with a muted snap, she leans slightly forward in the lamplight, delivering a tranquil goodnight message.
